mapper.select: SELECT app_id, name, name_ko FROM games

SELECT app_id, name, name_ko FROM games WHERE name ILIKE ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR name_ko ILIKE ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN lower(name) = lower(#{keyword}) OR name_ko = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN name ILIKE #{keyword} || '%' OR name_ko ILIKE #{keyword} || '%' THEN 1 WHEN name ILIKE '% ' || #{keyword} || '%' OR name_ko ILIKE '% ' || #{keyword} || '%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, length(name), app_id LIMIT 6
